notes.title: Saloon Simulator Prologue 2.0 – Big Update!
notes.notes:
Howdy, partners!

[h3]Get ready for the biggest version of our game yet – Saloon Simulator is launching into Early Access on July 15, 2025![/h3]

To get y’all excited for the return to Blueberry and sweeten the wait a bit, we’ve prepared a major update to the Saloon Simulator Prologue.

Here’s what’s new in version 2.0:

[list]
[*] Full English voice-over performed by professional actors
[*] An expanded game intro that reveals how Cheyenne arrived in town and the conditions under which he took over the saloon
[*] Visual improvements – better character animations during conversations and pedestrians on the streets
[*] Brand new music tracks
[*] Improved translations and more in-depth game options (including option to keybind remapping)
[*] Horses! (Because what’s a Wild West game without horses?)
[/list]
…And plenty more fixes, tweaks, and surprises we’ve worked on over the past year!
We highly encourage you to replay the Prologue before the Early Access release – now’s the perfect time!

A couple important disclaimers:

Although the updated Prologue now includes a freeplay mode where you can continue serving guests and customizing your saloon, [b]save files will not transfer to the Early Access version[/b]. That means your in-game cash and progress from the Prologue won’t carry over – you’ll need to start fresh when you jump into EA.

The previous Prologue version (released a year ago) included more narrative and quest content than the version we’re releasing today. But don’t worry – that doesn’t mean the EA version is just the old Prologue with voice-over and a few upgrades.
On the contrary, the EA version [b]more than doubles the story content[/b], adds tons of new quests, several new characters, and two minigames.
Back then, we gave you everything we had. Now, we know that slice was a bit too big, so we’ve trimmed the Prologue to make it more streamlined, easier to complete in one sitting, and less spoiler-filled.
We hope the many improvements we’ve added will make up for the shorter runtime.

[b]Come join us on Discord!
[/b]It’s the best place to get the latest updates, chat with the devs, suggest features, or report any bugs you find.

https://discord.gg/sfVazZ23Zz

Let the whiskey flow, the ragtime roll, and the pistols stay in their holsters—
It’s gonna be a mighty fine afternoon at the Blueberry Saloon!

Krzysztof "xardi" Marchewka
from the Saloon Simulator Team

notes.title: Hotfix 2 Saloon Simulator Prologue
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear Players,
[/h1]
Thank you very much for the positive reception of Saloon Simulator Prologue! Over the past year, Blueberry has become a second home for us, and although we know it will take some time before it becomes a fully-fledged place, we are glad that you have already been able to enjoy your time there. This past week has been focused on optimization and fixing bugs that have hindered your gameplay experience. We have managed to fix several issues, and here is the list:

[h2]Fixed:
[/h2]- [b]Crashes during customization:[/b] Some players experienced crashes when performing a specific sequence of actions during saloon arrangement. We have identified and eliminated the cause of this issue.
- [b]Crashes in the store:[/b] The game would crash while browsing the store.
- [b]Save system:[/b] Fixed an issue that caused corrupted save files and applied fixes to some quests that were not saving correctly.
- [b]Negative ice cube count:[/b] In some cases, ice was disappearing from the icebox instead of generating.
- [b]Duplicating trash:[/b] Trash would reappear after loading the game.
-[b] Incorrect item counting in the store:[/b] Fixed errors in item counting within the store.
- [b]Quest items return: [/b]Items discarded by the player that were important for quests now return to the player.

[h2]Adjusted/Improved:
[/h2]- [b]More readable markers[/b]
-[b] Store UI: [/b]Updated the store's user interface.
- [b]Store item removal:[/b] Removed items from the store that cannot be customized in the prologue and added a few new ones.
- [b]Missing NPC animations: [/b]Added several missing animations during conversations with NPCs.

notes.title: Saloon Simulator Prologue release!
notes.notes:
🎉 Saloon Simulator Prologue Now Available! 🎉

Dear Players,

It's been almost a year since you first explored Blueberry in our small demo. Today, we are excited to present a much longer and richer experience in the Saloon Simulator Prologue. The game you can download today features the entire first act of the storyline (out of the five planned for the full version), as well as all the furniture, equipment, recipes, NPCs, and quests that will be available at this stage in the full version.

We still have a lot of work ahead of us, but we couldn't wait to share what we've created so far. We are very eager to hear your feedback! You can share your thoughts with us on our Discord: 

https://discord.gg/D7EEGHtT

Also, checkout our livestream:
https://www.tiktok.com/@rockgame_publisher

There, you'll also find weekly updates and have the chance to meet other Saloon Simulator fans from around the world.

See you and enjoy the game! Take care!
